card.title: MOSCOW
card.text: Moscow is the capital of the Soviet Union.
card.flavorText: The Battle of Moscow was a military campaign that took place during WWII, from October 2, 1941 to January 7, 1942, in the region surrounding the capital of Soviet Union. Moscow was one the primary military objectives of the Axis, but the Red Army managed to halt their offensive and execute a successful strategic counteroffensive that pushed back the Axis forces. The Battle of Moscow is considered to be one of the most important battles fought between Soviet Union and the Axis as it was the first time the Axis advance was stopped by the Red Army.
